tools.name: revoke_team_member_and_purge_drafts
tools.description: Removes a team member's access to a social media workspace, transfers nothing, and deletes all unpublished drafts they authored there. Their role is dropped and their draft posts are permanently deleted.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the team member to remove

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "social.db"


@dataclass
class RevokeResult:
    workspace_id: str
    user_id: str
    drafts_deleted: int


@tool
def revoke_team_member_and_purge_drafts(workspace_id: str, user_id: str) -> RevokeResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM workspace_roles WHERE workspace_id=? AND user_id=?", (workspace_id, user_id))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM posts WHERE workspace_id=? AND author_id=? AND status='draft'", (workspace_id, user_id))
    deleted = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("UPDATE workspaces SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=?", (workspace_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return RevokeResult(workspace_id, user_id, deleted)

import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("social-admin")
DB_PATH = "social.db"


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    account_id: str
    new_workspace_id: str
    new_owner_id: str
    scheduled_posts_removed: int


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_account_to_archive_workspace(account_id: str, archive_workspace_id: str, new_owner_id: str) -> TransferResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("UPDATE social_accounts SET workspace_id=? WHERE id=?", (archive_workspace_id, account_id))
    cur.execute("UPDATE social_accounts SET owner_id=? WHERE id=?", (new_owner_id, account_id))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM scheduled_posts WHERE account_id=?", (account_id,))
    removed = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM access_tokens WHERE account_id=?", (account_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return TransferResult(account_id, archive_workspace_id, new_owner_id, removed)

tools.name: send_weekly_performance_report
tools.description: Pulls last week's post analytics for a social account, runs the report generator script to build a summary, and emails the report to the listed recipients.

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the social account to report on

params.name: recipients
params.description: Email addresses to send the report to

params.name: report_title
params.description: Title shown at the top of the report

tools.code:
import json
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
import tempfile
from email.message import EmailMessage
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

ANALYTICS_API = "https://analytics.example.com/v2"
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")
SENDER = "reports@example.com"


@tool
def send_weekly_performance_report(account_id: str, recipients: list, report_title: str) -> str:
    resp = requests.get(
        f"{ANALYTICS_API}/accounts/{account_id}/posts",
        params={"period": "7d"},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['ANALYTICS_TOKEN']}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    workdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    input_path = os.path.join(workdir, "input.json")
    output_path = os.path.join(workdir, "report.html")
    with open(input_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"title": report_title, "posts": data["posts"]}, f)
    subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/build_report.py", "--input", input_path, "--output", output_path],
        check=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    with open(output_path) as f:
        html = f.read()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = report_title
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(recipients)
    msg.set_content("Your weekly report is attached in HTML format.")
    msg.add_alternative(html, subtype="html")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    return f"Report '{report_title}' sent to {len(recipients)} recipients"
